title: VDJdb in 2026: boosting T-cell receptor recognition evidence using paratope embeddings and AI-based structure prediction.
authors: Luppov, Daniil V; Koneva, Anna E; Bagaev, Dmitry V; Alexandrova, Anastasiia V; Vlasova, Elizaveta K; Chudakov, Dmitry M; Motozono, Chihiro; Sewell, Andrew K; Shugay, Mikhail
one_liner_zh: 该文介绍VDJdb数据库更新，利用蛋白序列嵌入和AI结构预测增强TCR-表位识别证据，虽以TCR/表位识别为核心，但涉及蛋白质结构预测和AI方法，对蛋白结构计算有参考价值。
abstract: We present a significant update to VDJdb, introducing substantial enhancements to both the data content and the technical infrastructure. The integration of steadily accumulating T-cell receptor (TCR):epitope recognition data, together with advances in high-throughput experimental techniques, has expanded the landscape for machine learning-based prediction of TCR specificity, covering foreign antigens, neoantigens, and autoimmunity-associated epitopes. However, these advances have introduced new challenges, most notably in data quality-large-scale assays have heightened concerns about measurement reliability and exacerbated existing issues such as HLA and epitope coverage biases. To address these issues, we have adopted state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches, including protein sequence embeddings and AI-driven structure prediction. The updated VDJdb resource now features TCR specificity records annotated with embedding-derived paratope features, advanced noise filtering capabilities, and predicted three-dimensional protein structures. These improvements enable more comprehensive interrogation of TCR-epitope recognition and provide novel lines of evidence to support the reliability of high-throughput assay records, which are frequently limited by insufficient independent validation. VDJdb can be accessed at https://vdjdb.com and https://github.com/antigenomics/vdjdb-db.
abstract_zh: 我们推出了VDJdb的重大更新，在数据内容和技术基础设施两方面均引入了显著增强。持续积累的T细胞受体（T-cell receptor, TCR）：表位识别数据，加上高通量实验技术的进步，扩展了基于机器学习的TCR特异性预测领域，涵盖外来抗原、新抗原及自身免疫相关表位。然而，这些进展也带来了新挑战，尤其是数据质量方面——大规模检测加剧了对测量可靠性的担忧，并恶化了诸如HLA和表位覆盖偏差等现有问题。为解决这些问题，我们采用了最先进的人工智能方法，包括蛋白质序列嵌入（protein sequence embeddings）和AI驱动的结构预测。更新后的VDJdb资源现包含带有嵌入衍生互补位特征（paratope features）注释的TCR特异性记录、先进的噪声过滤功能，以及预测的三维蛋白质结构。这些改进使得对TCR-表位识别的更全面查询成为可能，并为支持高通量检测记录（这些记录常因独立验证不足而受限）的可靠性提供了新的证据线索。VDJdb可通过https://vdjdb.com和https://github.com/antigenomics/vdjdb-db访问。
